info.name: Hospital Patient Pathway - Camunda 8.9
info.description: Camunda 8.9 REST requests for CityAndRuralConjunction. Import the companion local environment. Run setup requests individually, complete the referral form in Tasklist, then choose ONE entry message. This collection is an interactive toolkit, not a sequential end-to-end runner. See README.zh-CN.md / README.md for setup, authentication and limitations.

request.description: Set the Postman working directory to HospitalPatientPathway. If files are not resolved, reselect 1-17.bpmn and all 16 .form files in the resources file field. Deploy them in ONE request. Do not manually set Content-Type; Postman supplies the multipart boundary.

Starts at Start_Tasklist. Complete R1_RegisterCheck in Tasklist before selecting ONE entry message. Empty referralId/patientId values are generated before sending. Clear both values before a new independent run.
